## Plugin reference

- Description: The daily plugin-records.verify job: on main, recomputes every plugin record a tree check pass reads (`./equin check --verify-records`) and fails when one disagrees with the shared store under the same key.
- Server:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/jobs/supervised-job.defineSupervisedJob`
    - `primitives/log-channels.defineLogSink`
  - Register: `defineSupervisedJob('plugin-records.verify')`
